name: Andrake
source:
A short and silly game in which you play as a dragon and an android! (Rated R for violence, drug use, and intense enjoyment of ice cream?)

[From [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=42126]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 30[/url] (Theme: Connected Worlds).

一款短小又滑稽的游戏，你将扮演一条龙和一个安卓机器人！（因暴力、药物使用，以及对冰淇淋的强烈享受而评为R级。）

[摘自[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=42126]Ludum Dare[/url]]
